Bank of Maharashtra reported a 41.4% increase in standalone net profit for the quarter ended September 2026 to Rs 2309.59 crore.

Shares were flat at Rs 75.48 on the NSE.

Mankind Pharma reported standalone net profit of Rs 581.95 crore in Q2FY27 as against Rs 459.80 crore in Q2FY26.

Approved scheme of arrangement for amalgamation of Prolijune Lifesciences Private Limited and Pavi Buildwell Private Limited, both being wholly owned subsidiaries of the Company, with and into Mankind Pharma Limited.

Board also took note of the Scheme of Arrangement for amalgamation of Upakarma Ayurveda Private Limited with and into Mankind Consumer Products Pvt Ltd.

Shares surged over 4% to Rs 2,312 on the NSE.

Ather Energy - Annual Capacity enhancement by 2.25 lakh units

To meet rising demand, Ather will increase annual production capacity at Hosur by 75,000 units, from 4.2lakh to 4.95 lakh units by December 2026. Ather’s new facility in AURIC, Chhatrapati Sambhajinagar, ison track to begin commercial production in phases from December 2026, with Phase 1 having an annualproduction capacity of 5 lakh units. Ather will further expand the plant’s annual capacity by 1.5 lakh unitsto 6.5 lakh units, with the additional capacity expected to commence production by Q2 FY28.With these expansions, Ather’s combined installed annual capacity across Hosur and AURIC will reachapproximately 11.4 lakh units by Q2 FY28. The company will invest approximately ₹122 crore across thetwo facilities to support these capacity enhancements.

Ather saw a sharp rise in customer interest, with enquiries up 109% YoY to about 10 lakh, while pre-orders more than doubled to 1.80 lakh in Q2 FY27. Demand outpaced available production capacity, with the Hosur facility operating at 98% capacity utilisation during peak production in Q2 FY27

Tata Consumer Products traded 3% lower at Rs 933.85 on the NSE at 2.58 pm. Q2 results today.

Triveni Power Transmission Limited (TPTL), a leading manufacturer of high-speed gearboxes and engineered power transmission solutions, today announced its financial results for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026. In its first results announcement since listing, the Company reported Q2 FY27 revenue of ₹116 crores, up 5.7% year-on-year and 59.9% sequentially. EBITDA was reported at ₹42 crores, with a healthy margin of 36.1%, while profit after tax (PAT) stood at ₹26 crores.
